purpose: Matched test of modest early-frame AE weighting on the 500-frame, 200-MD-step joint low-temperature dynamics recipe.

intervention.target: AE normalized coordinate reconstruction loss only
intervention.normalization: divide all weights by their mean, preserving a 4:1 early-to-late ratio and mean weight 1
intervention.validation: the same weighted coordinate objective is used for checkpoint selection

fixed: Fresh 2D message-passing reference16 AE, one ordinary warmup epoch, at most 60 weighted epochs with patience 12, Adam 1e-4 and weight decay 1e-5; frozen one-step delta-MLP propagator over all 499 transitions, same optimizer, budget, graph context and coordinate-only selection as the completed joint_low seed123 baseline.
primary_evaluation: Post-fit AE reconstruction and autonomous rollout p-ratio R2 from physical positions, source-wise by horizon with valid/total counts.
qualification: Single-seed matched pilot. Heldout development IDs are evaluated only after both checkpoints freeze and do not select the model.
